title: Paced speech recognition in the signed app
summary: All eight signed-app model cases passed across 45 warmed paced holds. Live text, committed text and release-final clocks are reported separately.

environment.workload: Normal desktop apps; coordinated serial window with no concurrent native build/model job. Existing swap/desktop pressure retained in per-model context; no concurrent voice qualification.
environment.power_thermal: Per-model power/thermal/load/swap observations retained. Cold preparation is separate from warmed timing.

provenance.model: Pinned artifacts in shared/asr-artifacts.json; existing owner v3 cache
provenance.source: Signed build800,0.2.24; executableSHA25632a35bfcf9220dbdc87734466ccd63b9df1dc0a5e2488d1541b7e08a4207c8ed; ASR source frozen761f42ad plus DictationController attributionaf77cb3a; SDK fallback bundles hidden
provenance.command: Tools/asr_app_compare.py; exact per-model argv in native/runner.json

limitations: Authored PCM replay exercises the app engine, scheduler and transcript consumer; physical microphone, UI insertion, cleanup and concurrent voice remain unverified.
Short-excerpt latency and full-fixture accuracy are separate measurements; this is not whole-app dictation latency.
